name: Causal DAG (confounder + mediator)
author: PrismNext
description: Standard causal graph: unobserved $U$, confounder $Z$, treatment $X$, mediator $M$, outcome $Y$, including the direct $X\to Y$ edge.

parameters.name: \zlabel
parameters.meaning: confounder node (use \\ for a second line)

operations.summary: delete one \draw[flow] if that arrow is not in the claimed DAG
add an obs/unobs node with a semantic name and connect with flow arrows
change a style's palette name; never a hex/stock color

invariants: preserve the node names (u) (z) (x) (m) (y) unless the user dropped that variable
unobserved variables stay on the unobs (dashed) style
colors only via the five palette names
